title: DocWeaver MCP Integration Guide
description: Connect any MCP-aware AI agent to DocWeaver's document intelligence capabilities — extraction, summarization, and classification.

architecture.summary: DocWeaver exposes document intelligence through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Any MCP-aware AI agent — Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or your own custom agent — can call DocWeaver tools using natural language.

authModes.useCase: Local dev, internal tools, CI pipelines

installation:
cd leap_docweaver_mcp
uv sync          
uv run python server.py
# Server is ready at http://0.0.0.0/mcp

clients.name: Claude (Anthropic)
clients.description: Add DocWeaver MCP endpoint in Claude's Custom Tools settings

tools: Lists available OCR providers, LLM providers, and models
Extracts named fields (invoice number, total, etc.) per a JSON schema
Produces a prose summary of the document
Assigns document to named categories (severity, type, priority, etc.)
Returns the result of any previously submitted job by Ticket ID
Lists recent jobs — useful for recovering a lost Ticket ID

oauthFlow.description: When an end-user AI client (Claude, Cursor, VS Code) connects without a pre-shared token, the following flow happens automatically. Understanding it helps you debug auth issues and configure redirect_uris correctly.
keyPoints: The client_id from POST /register must match what the AI client sends during /authorize.
PKCE (code_challenge + code_verifier) is mandatory — no client_secret is used.
Access tokens are short-lived RS256 JWTs signed with the backend's RSA private key. The MCP server verifies them using GET /auth/jwks.
Refresh tokens can be exchanged for new access tokens using POST /token with grant_type=refresh_token.

troubleshooting: Client did not complete OAuth login flow
Re-trigger the OAuth flow so the client obtains a fresh access token
Register via POST /register or re-activate via PUT /clients/{client_id}
URI not in client's registered list
Add it via PUT /clients/{client_id} with updated redirect_uris
JWT auth requires JWKS_URI or PUBLIC_KEY
Call check_job_status to poll; check backend worker logs

changes: Initial MCP server release with OAuth 2.0, JWT, and static token auth modes
PKCE support for public OAuth clients (Claude, Copilot, Cursor)
